scope: baseline original localization behavior with optional bounded observer only; no R28 install, no candidate score, no claim of full navigation validation
groups: last original-qualified job before first later rejection
first post-anchor rejected independently produced query
first later independent query reaching original anchor age>3s
stop: original runner-owned cleanup after evidence window/capture failure/new navigation failure/budget cap or hard time cap; no unrelated process signals
memory_bound_scope: Retained source .data payload plus temporary CDR payload buffers only; excludes original worker, Python-object overhead, allocator and ROS runtime. Retained complete source refs <=5 groups; selected queued/inflight groups <=4; serializer/deserializer only single-writer.
